passage.title: Paragraph with errors
paras: the refugees walked for two night's, they was tired but they never gave up. When they reached the border a woman gave them bread. she asked there names and wrote them down slowly. its a small detail but it shows that someone cared. i think this is the most important moment in the poem

blocks.answers: Corrected: The (capital) refugees walked for two nights (no apostrophe). They (comma splice fixed) were (agreement) tired... She (capital) asked their (their) names... It's (it's) a small detail... I (capital) think this is the most important moment in the poem. (missing full stop)

head: Check
Ask yourself
rows: Does each sentence end with a full stop?
Belonging or missing letters, never plurals
One image, one pattern, used on purpose?

head: Not this
This
rows: The poem's are about people's live's.
The poems are about people's lives.

model.title: Edit: 'the refugees walked for two night's, they was tired but they never gave up'

parts.text: Capital T for the sentence start
Fix the comma splice: full stop

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The refugees walked for two nights. Exhausted, they still never gave up.

keywords.def: where one sentence ends and the next begins
a mark for missing letters or for belonging
mixing short, long and different sentence openings

questions.q: Correct: 'its a poem about hope, it's message is clear'
questions.a: It's a poem about hope. Its message is clear.

questions.q: Rewrite with a different opening: 'The kite flew above the town.'
questions.a: For example: 'Above the town, the kite flew.'

questions.a: For example: both; errors distract the reader from the idea.
